subject.title: fix(agents): add size limit to LSP message parser

question: Should every configured embedded LSP server be subject to an unconditional 10 MB response-frame limit?
rationale: The hard limit is a new compatibility boundary, and the repository contains no established contract or representative live evidence proving that 10 MB is safe for every configured server.

options.title: Keep 10 MB after validation
options.body: Retain the fixed limit after the ordering defect is repaired and representative real LSP servers are shown to remain within the boundary.

options.title: Choose an owner-approved boundary
options.body: Revise the threshold or bounded-stream policy using runtime-owner knowledge and real response-size evidence.

options.title: Avoid a universal hard limit
options.body: Pause this implementation and pursue another bounded parsing design if no safe common response limit can be established.

recommendation.title: Keep 10 MB after validation
recommendation.body: Retain the fixed limit after the ordering defect is repaired and representative real LSP servers are shown to remain within the boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available current-main history signal for this runtime path, although the shallow checkout limits provenance certainty.
